title: Eval replay sessions never outlive their run directory
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15: node --test pid running 2d17h with cwd /mnt/storage/tmp/d23-runs/533.P.r1 (deleted), killed by hand.
Outcome: evals/d23 replay runs each session in its own process group and kills it when the run ends or times out.
Proof: test spawns a replay with a hanging child and asserts no process with that cwd survives.
